mechanism: Chlorpromazine may impair glucose metabolism and antagonize the glycemic effects of empagliflozin, while empagliflozin increases genital infection risk due to glycosuria and chlorpromazine causes orthostatic hypotension and CNS effects that may be additive.
action: Monitor blood glucose closely and assess need for empagliflozin dose adjustment; monitor for orthostatic hypotension and advise caution with activities requiring alertness; educate on genital infection prevention.
